resources.string: Your account and all your apps will no longer be usable. This can’t be undone.\n\nYour share links and Explore listings will be taken down. Data on this device is also erased. Posts in apps shared with others remain.
Data on this device will be erased, and you can’t return to this anonymous account. You won’t be able to open the apps and records you made.
Data on this device will be erased. Sign in again to get back the apps you made and the records already sent.
